entities.summary: The Cathedral of the Virgin of the Snows is a Roman Catholic cathedral in the city of Ibiza, Spain. Located in the Dalt Vila, the historic centre of the city, it is the seat of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Ibiza since 1817.
